style.description: Cozy chunky pixel art. Plants: front-facing potted plants in terracotta pots, single-color dark outlines, medium shading, warm saturated palette. Tiles: isometric grass-top block with dirt cross-section, lineless, basic shading.

tile_pipeline: Terrain tiles are post-processed, never used raw. Raw PixelLab output lives in assets/images/garden/tiles/raw/. Pipeline: (1) scripts/seamless_tile.py strips the diorama fringe so tops run clean to the diamond edges; (2) scripts/mockup_tile.py rebuilds the grass tile by UV-sampling singleTileGarden.png directly (top + dirt sides + lip), harvests flower pixels onto the flowers variant, and gives soil/path/water the same mockup dirt sides. Rerun both after regenerating any raw tile.
